overview_description.description: UBQT is a social networking and community management platform focused on facilitating in-person connections and real-world meetups. The platform allows individuals, organizations, alumni groups, conferences, and professional communities to coordinate face-to-face interactions through location-based notifications, calendar syncing, travel coordination, and event management tools. UBQT provides mobile and web applications that help users discover when their contacts are nearby, traveling to the same location, or attending the same events.
